title: AlphaSense Surpasses $700M ARR, Named Only Leader in Forrester Wave for Market and Competitive Intelligence
summary: AlphaSense said it was recognized as the only Leader in The Forrester Wave: Market and Competitive Intelligence Platforms, Q3 2026, receiving the highest possible scores in 14 of 29 evaluation criteria. In the same release the company said it surpassed $700 million in annual recurring revenue in Q2 2026, serves more than 7,800 customers worldwide, and that over 90 percent of research projects on AlphaSense are being performed by agents, with the platform consuming 500 billion LLM tokens weekly.
whyItMatters: ARR moved from $600M+ in Q1 to $700M+ in Q2 2026 — roughly $100M of ARR added in a single quarter — underscoring how far the platform model has pulled ahead in scale.
